databases.name: MB08-165
databases.title: Mindless Benchmark of 165 molecules containing 8 atoms
databases.blurb: Korth and Grimme's "mindless" benchmark: 165 artificial, randomly generated 8-atom molecules of the main-group elements H to Cl (no noble gases), uncharged, single-reference, about 25% open-shell. It combines the 931 set (83 systems, PBE/TZVP geometries) and the ORG set (84 systems, PBE/TZVPP geometries) without their two duplicates. Superseded by MB16-43 but still useful.

refs.text: Korth, M.; Grimme, S. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2009, 5 (4), 993-1003.

subsets.name: MB08-165
subsets.description: Reaction energies of the decomposition of the 165 artificial 8-atom molecules into simple hydrides (groups 1-4) and diatomics (groups 5-7). Reactions 1-81 are the systems 1-83 of the 931 set (without 12 and 49, which also appear in the ORG set), reactions 82-165 are the ORG set; reference values from the supporting information.

subsets.name: MB08-165-AE
subsets.description: Atomisation reference energies of the 165 artificial 8-atom molecules of MB08-165 (same numbering as the decomposition energies), from the supporting information of Korth and Grimme. Not part of the ACCDB csv files.
